derivation: ext b; simpa [quotMk, quotFactor] using congrArg (fun f => f b) (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ_comp_mk (R₁ := 𝓞) (hIJ := (h : I.1 ≤ J.1)))
explanation: The Mathlib lemma says that the quotient-factor algebra hom composed with the quotient map is the quotient map to the larger ideal. Unfolding the two local morphism definitions gives the target identity; the current proof establishes it by extensionality and reduction instead.
